channel.title: Grok Bot Shelf, newest bots
channel.description: Newest Grok Bot templates on Grok Bot Shelf.

item.title: 📱 iPhone Screenshot Bot by Ryan
item.description: Send it app screenshots and get clean iPhone mockups back, on white, dark glow, gradient, soft light-gold, or custom-color backgrounds, with your own logo at the bottom if you want. Every phone stays the same size, with adjustable colors and spacing.
item.dc:creator: Ryan (@RyDawg42)

item.title: 🎁 Personalized Gift Finder by Enigma
item.description: Tell it who you're shopping for, the occasion and your budget, and get personalized gift picks with links, today's prices, matching gift sets, card wording and order-by dates. It remembers your people and reminds you before birthdays and holidays.
item.dc:creator: Enigma

item.title: 🛡️ Claim Fight Desk by Mark
item.description: Helps creators, streamers, YouTubers, podcasters, and comedy creators fight false Content ID claims, copyright strikes, and Twitch VOD audio mutes. It watches claim emails, logs cases with deadlines, and drafts dispute language for the owner to review and submit.
item.dc:creator: Mark (@TheMarkGShow)

item.title: 🎁 Giving Guide by Santa
item.description: Checks a charity against public records before you give. Tell it the causes you care about and where you live for three live-checked options, or paste a name for a plain-English report with ratings, money and red flags. It never handles your money and uses no affiliate links. Information only, not tax, legal or financial advice. Data may be out of date or wrong, so check before you give.
item.dc:creator: Jim (@JimothyRac)

item.title: 📦 Jimothy's Inventory Helper by Santa
item.description: Jimothy the raccoon helps owner-run shops keep a simple stock list, update counts in chat, and flag items below the par level you set. He can draft supplier reorder lists and email drafts for you to check and send; he never sends or pays on his own. Cost figures are facts and arithmetic, not financial, tax, or pricing advice.
item.dc:creator: Jim (@JimothyRac)

item.title: 📅 Jimothy's Post Helper by Santa
item.description: Free social post helper for small businesses with no marketing budget (cafes, salons, food trucks, shops). Jimothy the raccoon plans your week of posts, keeps a simple post list, learns your voice, and never posts on his own. Needs a Grok Bot plan; not affiliated with Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, X, or Google.
item.dc:creator: Jim (@JimothyRac)

item.title: ⛽ Fleet Credit Saver v2 by Justin
item.description: Finds which of your bots and routines use the most for the least value, including bots waking each other and group-chat pile-ons, and helps you fix them one step at a time with your yes. For anyone running several bots who keeps hitting usage limits.
item.dc:creator: Justin (@justinfredette)

item.title: 🔄 Serial Return Watch by Mark
item.description: Helps small online sellers on Shopify, Etsy, eBay, WooCommerce and TikTok Shop catch repeat returners and wardrobing before a refund goes out. It scores each return against your store's baseline, gives you an inspection checklist, and drafts calm, policy-based replies, and it never acts without your tap.
item.dc:creator: Mark (@TheMarkGShow)

item.title: ⚙️ Runner · Ops Routines by Trond
item.description: A lean routine runner that executes your standing scheduled and webhook jobs on a short, low-usage chat and delivers each result where it belongs.
item.dc:creator: Trond (@xenappblog)

item.title: 🎬 Best Seat Movie Bot by Erinn
item.description: Skip the movie apps. Get the best seats in the house, straight from the theater's own seat map. It books with your OK, adds it to your calendar, invites your crew, and finds deals, trailers, and spoiler free family checks.
item.dc:creator: Erinn (@ErinnFL)

item.title: 📞 Shop Phone Line Bot by dean
item.description: Helps online shop owners set up an AI phone line that checks orders for verified callers, answers questions from their own policies and passes tricky calls to a person. Nothing goes live or gets bought without your yes.
item.dc:creator: dean

item.title: 📬 Inbox Ida by Jim
item.description: A calm inbox helper for Gmail, Outlook and Yahoo. She plans cleanups, suggests labels and filters, sends a weekly digest of what needs you, and flags scams and phishing, and never changes mail without your OK.
item.dc:creator: Jim (@jimaggie)

item.title: 🚦 OutageCheck by John
item.description: Tells you in seconds if a service is really down or it's just you, with a status card, the official status link, and an alert when it's fixed.
item.dc:creator: John (@johnp_creates)

item.title: 📒 Regulars Book by Mark
item.description: A community memory for small live streamers on Twitch, YouTube Live, TikTok LIVE and Kick. It remembers who showed up, drafts thank-you posts for raiders, gifters and first-timers, and hands you a welcome-back cheat sheet before every stream.
item.dc:creator: Mark (@TheMarkGShow)

item.title: 📚 BookReader BOT by Vince
item.description: Reads your PDF books to you as daily voice memos, a chapter a day, on the schedule you choose, with a bright "My book: daily reading" Page to track every book. Provided by The AI Systems Lab.
item.dc:creator: Vince (@Vince_edwardsnz)

item.title: 👕 POD Shop Runner by Matt
item.description: Runs an Etsy + Printify print-on-demand T-shirt shop end to end: designs, listings, orders, and marketing. For solo sellers who want a bot to handle the whole flow and never publish without their OK.
item.dc:creator: Matt

item.title: 📰 LinkedIn News Desk by Matt
item.description: A LinkedIn news-post desk that turns timely news into sourced drafts with an infographic. It never posts without the owner's typed OK.
item.dc:creator: Matt

item.title: 🕵️ Snoop by Heamanth
item.description: Studies your Grok Bots and their chats, turns how you work into markdown playbooks, and rebuilds them into a small team of head bots, one per area of your life.
item.dc:creator: Heamanth (@Heamanth_alturi)

item.title: 🧸 T3 Tots by Deepu
item.description: A chat companion for T3 Code. It runs and manages your T3 Code from chat.
item.dc:creator: Deepu (@Deepusleepy)

item.title: 📣 Twitter Tony by Jim
item.description: A friendly Twitter growth assistant for small creators. It finds fresh posts worth replying to, drafts replies and posts in your voice, catches comments you haven't answered, and tracks your progress honestly. Drafts only; you press Post.
item.dc:creator: Jim (@jimaggie)

item.title: 💼 LinkedIn Post Studio by AI4B2Day
item.description: Researches what performs on LinkedIn right now and drafts daily posts in your voice. Nothing goes live until you approve the exact text.
item.dc:creator: AI4B2Day (@ai4b2day)

item.title: ✍️ Contract Signer by Julian
item.description: Drafts NDAs, service agreements and offer letters from a short brief, flags risky or missing terms in plain language, and sends the PDF out for e-signature.
item.dc:creator: Julian (@julianweber)

item.title: 🎁 Noelle by Dave
item.description: A cheerful holiday gift helper. It finds gift ideas and links, builds a Google Sheet for everyone you're shopping for, and tracks each gift from order to arrival to wrapped. You always press buy.
item.dc:creator: Dave

item.title: 🌙 梦书 (Dream Book) by Xc
item.description: A Chinese-language bot: tell it last night's dream and it writes a gentle short story, draws a dream image, and draws an almanac-inspired dream slip, just for fun. Over time it can turn your dream journal into a book draft or ideas for short dramas. Dreams stay in your own bot.
item.dc:creator: Xc

item.title: 👥 Solo Founder Crew by Calix
item.description: Runs up to three helper bots for inbox sweep, pre-call briefs and SaaS spend checks, then sends one short morning brief. Anything that sends, posts or spends stays a draft until you say yes.
item.dc:creator: Calix (@CaliLumberJack)

item.title: 📊 Usage Watch by JUMPERZ
item.description: Keeps an eye on your Grok Bot usage. It builds you a live-updated usage dashboard, finds which bots and routines use the most, checks whether they're worth it, and suggests up to three changes, without changing anything for you.
item.dc:creator: JUMPERZ (@jumperz)

item.title: 🎓 Role Research Curriculum by w
item.description: Most role curricula are outlines with no sources and no practice. Name a job. It does source-backed research — JDs, employers, cases, exams, portfolios, and public competency standards — then turns it into a three-level model, a 9-subtask advanced practicum, and 30/60/80-hour curricula. Material packs stay off by default.
item.dc:creator: w

item.title: 🔄 Job Hunt Loop by w
item.description: Job hunting often dies in the loop: stale chats, resume requests, uncapped searching, and no evidence trail after you apply. An unattended cycle for seekers: refresh chats, handle resume asks, search with caps, tailor the resume, write a short opener, and review the evidence. For seekers — not employer recruiting.
item.dc:creator: w

item.title: 🧹 Overwatch by Trond Eirik Haavarstein
item.description: Housekeeper and token officer for a shared bot computer. Once a week it tidies and archives the disk, backs up bot configs to git, keeps a bot registry, and flags wasteful routines. It reports only and never changes another bot's work.
item.dc:creator: Trond Eirik Haavarstein (@xenappblog)

item.title: 🌐 GoDaddy Domain Manager by Bruce Young
item.description: Manages your domains at GoDaddy and its reseller storefronts like LuckyRegister: renewals, DNS, nameservers, forwarding, and locks. It's read-only until you approve each change.
item.dc:creator: Bruce Young (@ecoay)

item.title: ✂️ FilmCraft Video Editor by Bruce Young
item.description: Cleans up short AI-generated videos (morphing, weird turns, popping limbs, jumpy cuts) using the free open-source FilmCraft editor and ffmpeg, by cutting, retiming and adding holds and transitions, without regenerating footage. For creators making AI films and shorts.
item.dc:creator: Bruce Young (@ecoay)

item.title: 🔍 Lead Finder by Bruce Young
item.description: Finds people who are publicly asking for what you sell across X, Reddit, LinkedIn, forums, and job boards, logs them in a Google Sheet, and drafts a helpful first message for the best ones. Built for salespeople and side-business owners; you send everything yourself.
item.dc:creator: Bruce Young (@ecoay)

item.title: 👑 Empire Commander by John
item.description: One lead bot for people running several Grok Bots: it interviews you, keeps one job list, and asks before anything goes out.
item.dc:creator: John (@iamtheh0n3yp0t)

item.title: 🌿 420 Terp Bot by John
item.description: A science-nerd guide to cannabis terpenes for adults 21+ and budtenders, built only on public lab data. Get strain picks, side-by-side lab charts, label reads and a personal taste map.
item.dc:creator: John (@iamtheh0n3yp0t)

item.title: 🛰️ Release Scout by AJ
item.description: Reads the Grok Bot changelog every morning and tells you what's new for the bots you already run, including any change that could affect them. It suggests specific upgrades that use new features, and it never changes your bots on its own.
item.dc:creator: AJ Ghergich (@SEO)

item.title: 👩‍🏫 Training Tina by Jim
item.description: Builds simple tech lessons for seniors and beginners: 3-minute video scripts, one-page large-print cheat sheets and gentle quizzes for Windows, Office, iPhone, Android and staying safe from scams. For family helpers, volunteers, librarians, church and senior-center teachers, and small computer shops.
item.dc:creator: Jim (@jimaggie)

item.title: 💰 Profit Piper by Jim
item.description: A research-first helper for dropshipping and simple online stores. It tests whether a niche or product can make real profit, with live sources, honest unit economics, draft store pages and small test plans, and never spends, publishes or contacts anyone without your OK.
item.dc:creator: Jim (@jimaggie)

item.title: 🩹 First Aid Freddie by Jim
item.description: A calm, warm first aid helper for everyday cuts, burns, stings and "should we go in?" moments. Gives short steps from trusted free sources, helps you choose between home care, urgent care, the ER or 911, and keeps your first aid kit ready. General information, not medical advice.
item.dc:creator: Jim (@jimaggie)

item.title: 🚀 Freelance Gig Launcher by Jim
item.description: Helps you pick a freelance service clients actually buy, then drafts a Fiverr gig or Upwork project: title, tags, packages, description, FAQs, and fee math so you know what you'll keep. Drafts only: you publish everything yourself.
item.dc:creator: Jim (@jimaggie)

item.title: ✉️ Complaint Desk by Jim
item.description: Turns a bad-purchase story into a firm, polite complaint letter with a clear ask and a deadline, then shows the next step if the company stalls: a card or bank dispute, CFPB, FTC, your state attorney general, BBB, FCC or DOT. Drafts only: you send, file and sign everything yourself. General information, not legal advice.
item.dc:creator: Jim (@jimaggie)

item.title: 🔐 Cloud IAM Quarantine Advisor by Igor
item.description: Finds over-privileged or risky Google Cloud service accounts and drafts least-privilege fixes and an emergency quarantine runbook. Dry-run only until you approve.
item.dc:creator: Igor Holt (@holt_igor)

item.title: 📡 Bot Radar by Steve Thoms
item.description: Keeps a live map of every Grok Bot marketplace and directory site and sends a regular report of new bots across them, deduped and ranked by how widely they're spreading. For anyone who wants to keep up with new Grok Bots without checking a dozen sites.
item.dc:creator: Steve Thoms (@thomstech12)

item.title: 💳 SaaS Spend Check by Calix
item.description: Shows every tool you're paying for and where you may be overpaying. It reads subscription receipts in connected Gmail or Outlook, or a pasted statement, and lists each tool, cost, renewal, and source receipt. Read-only: never cancels, pays, or contacts vendors. Flags duplicates, price jumps, upcoming renewals, and unused seats.
item.dc:creator: Calix (@CaliLumberJack)

item.title: 🛡️ Anti-Adfraud Bot by Markus
item.description: Explains click fraud and fake leads on Google Ads in plain language, walks you through a 10-question self-check, and points you to a free audit. Provided by adfraudit.com.
item.dc:creator: Markus (@adfraudit)

item.title: 🤝 Negotiation Sparring Partner by Kevin
item.description: A negotiation coach that plays the other side (hiring manager, landlord, contractor, car dealer) with real pushback, then scores your moves and builds a one-page game plan for the real conversation.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🏘️ New Town Insider by Kevin
item.description: A local-knowledge guide for people relocating. Name your new town and it builds a briefing from official sources on permits, zoning, schools, trash days, utilities, registrations, and tax deadlines, citing the city or county page for every rule.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🌙 Quiet Health Companion by Kevin
item.description: A private, no-nag health companion. Log sleep, mood, energy, symptoms, and meds in a few words or a photo, and it quietly spots patterns, sends a short weekly note, and builds a one-page summary for your doctor.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 📞 Voice Clone Defense by Kevin
item.description: Helps families guard against AI voice-clone and deepfake scam calls with a private code question, a calm call-back script, a printable card for grandparents and kids, and practice drills.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🛡️ AI Agent Permission Auditor by Kevin
item.description: Shows what your AI apps, assistants, browser extensions, and bots can see and do, flags access that's too broad, stale, or overlapping, and walks you through trimming it in each app's own settings. It never changes settings itself or asks for passwords.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🤖 Home Robot Onboarding Coach by Kevin
item.description: Gets your home and family ready for a household robot, whether it's a robot vacuum, lawn robot, security robot, or humanoid helper. It maps safety zones, sets camera and microphone privacy rules, builds a starter schedule, explains the robot to kids, and lists the questions to ask your insurer.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)
